content:
According to reports, new Apple products will launch on October 13, including the rumored "HomePad" device. But according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman, one rumored product will not appear next month: a new full-size HomePod equipped with Siri AI.

The full-size HomePod will not receive an October update, but according to Bloomberg's report, a new version will eventually be released.

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported today that Apple plans to unveil three brand new home products in the near future.

The expected release date for each of the above products is Tuesday, October 13.

This is his only mention of the full-size HomePod product, which has not been updated since 2023.

Top Liked Comment by OliveBus

Just updated our HomePod to v27 (24J361). Even after years of ownership, the sound quality remains excellent. Used as a stereo pair via AirPlay with an Apple TV Gen2 and a Bose soundbar (with wireless subwoofer and two rear speakers).

Taking a wait-and-see approach on new products, hoping they will be worth the wait and that the updates won't break existing Homies (HomePod nickname).

Gurman reported earlier this year that a new full-size HomePod is in development, alongside updated HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K models. When asked about the launch timing of these products, he said: "It's just a matter of time. They want to make sure Apple Intelligence and the new Siri features work properly on these products before releasing the new versions."

Although Siri AI has officially launched and the HomePod mini is already ready with the relevant support, it seems that supporters of the full-size HomePod will have to wait longer for a hardware update compatible with Siri AI.

Hopefully the wait won't be too long, because in just a few short weeks, the full-size HomePod will be the only home product still running on the old version of Siri.

Which new Apple home product are you most looking forward to? Are you planning to buy a new HomePod? Let us know in the comments.
